demos.title: X bit flip
demos.description: Flips one qubit from |0> to |1>.
demos.expected: The final |1> probability is 1.

demos.title: H superposition
demos.description: Splits the initial amplitude equally between |0> and |1>.
demos.expected: Both basis states have probability 0.5.

demos.title: RX quarter turn
demos.description: Rotates around the Bloch-sphere X axis by pi/2 radians.
demos.expected: The displayed probabilities are 0.5 and 0.5; RX also creates an imaginary amplitude.

demos.title: RY quarter turn
demos.description: Rotates around the Y axis by pi/2 radians using real amplitude mixing.
demos.expected: The displayed probabilities are 0.5 and 0.5.

demos.title: RZ phase change
demos.description: Adds opposite phases to the |0> and |1> components after H.
demos.expected: Probabilities remain 0.5 and 0.5 because RZ changes phase, not magnitude.

demos.title: Combined one-qubit sequence
demos.description: Applies H, RY, RZ and RX in order to show that gate order forms one transformation.
demos.expected: The trace shows a valid normalized state after every operation.

demos.title: Phase becomes probability
demos.description: H creates superposition, RZ(pi) changes relative phase, and the final H converts that phase into a visible outcome.
demos.expected: The final state is |1> with probability 1.

demos.title: Bell state
demos.description: H creates a branch and CX correlates the second qubit with the first.
demos.expected: Only |00> and |11> remain, each with probability 0.5.

demos.title: Three-qubit GHZ state
demos.description: Two CX gates extend one superposed control across three qubits.
demos.expected: Only |000> and |111> remain, each with probability 0.5.

demos.title: CX without entanglement
demos.description: The control is definitely 1, so CX performs a deterministic target flip rather than creating entanglement.
demos.expected: The final basis state is |11> with probability 1.

demos.title: Repeated CX
demos.description: Applying the same CX twice reverses its first action while preserving both occurrences in the circuit.
demos.expected: The final probabilities are |00>=0.5 and |01>=0.5 in the simulator's displayed bit order.

demos.title: Direct CX route
demos.description: The mapped control and target share an edge.
demos.expected: DIRECT, path 0->1, distance 1, zero SWAPs and one total CX equivalent.

demos.title: Indirect CX route
demos.description: BFS must route between endpoints that are connected but not adjacent.
demos.expected: INDIRECT, path 0->1->2, distance 2, two SWAPs and seven total CX equivalents.

demos.title: Unreachable CX
demos.description: The mapped control and target lie in different graph components.
demos.expected: UNREACHABLE with path, distance and complete cost reported as NA.

demos.title: Same circuit: line
demos.description: Runs the fixed three-CX workload on the four-vertex line.
demos.expected: Observed acceptance values: distances 1,3,1; 4 SWAPs; 12 extra CX; 15 total CX.

demos.title: Same circuit: shortcut
demos.description: Uses identical circuit text and adds only the physical 0-3 edge.
demos.expected: Observed acceptance values: distances 1,1,1; zero SWAPs; 3 total CX.

demos.title: Same circuit: disconnected
demos.description: Uses identical circuit text on two disconnected hardware components.
demos.expected: Distances 1,NA,1 and unavailable complete workload cost.

demos.title: Original XOR training
demos.description: Runs the production two-qubit forward path and 200-epoch finite-difference trainer.
demos.expected: The four training examples are classified correctly. The same examples are used for evaluation.

demos.title: XOR encoding-only baseline
demos.description: Applies only binary RY encoding and odd-parity readout.
demos.expected: The four XOR labels are already exact, which limits the learning claim.

demos.title: Initialized full PQC
demos.description: Runs the full production circuit with fixed untrained parameters.
demos.expected: Shows predictions before optimization using theta 0.2, 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8.

demos.title: Trained full PQC
demos.description: Trains through the production function and prints only the final structured predictions.
demos.expected: The final probabilities classify all four training examples correctly.

demos.title: Zero-parameter full PQC
demos.description: Runs the full architecture with every trainable angle set to zero.
demos.expected: Provides a control separating architecture and encoding effects from learned angles.

demos.title: Angle encoding and variational gates
demos.description: Shows feature RY rotations, parameter RY rotations, one CX and a final parameter layer as a readable circuit file.
demos.expected: The actual simulator trace shows the state after every supported gate.

demos.title: Negative test: unknown gate
demos.description: Uses unsupported gate Z.
demos.expected: The production parser rejects line 2 and no circuit prefix executes.

demos.title: Negative test: missing argument
demos.description: Omits the CX target operand.
demos.expected: The parser reports a malformed gate and simulation does not begin.

demos.title: Negative test: qubit range
demos.description: Addresses qubit 2 in a two-qubit circuit.
demos.expected: The parser reports the physical source line and rejects the circuit.

demos.title: Negative test: nonfinite angle
demos.description: Uses NaN as a rotation angle.
demos.expected: The parser rejects the nonfinite value.

demos.title: Negative test: topology vertex
demos.description: Uses endpoint 4 in a four-vertex graph whose valid IDs are 0 through 3.
demos.expected: The topology loader rejects the edge and analysis does not run.
